properties.name: Saylani mobile kitchens
properties.what: Mobile kitchens scaled to roughly 250,000 hot meals per day at peak, serving flood-affected families across central Sindh.
properties.needs: Ongoing food security support, local logistics, and verified field updates.
properties.verification_status: reported by organization; cited in research brief
properties.source: Saylani Welfare Trust; EcoLens research brief

properties.name: JDC volunteer boat rescues
properties.what: Volunteer boats supported first-wave rescues and movement through flooded settlements before formal systems fully arrived.
properties.needs: Field interviews, survivor testimony, and verified route mapping.
properties.verification_status: reported by organization; needs field documentation

properties.name: Al-Khidmat shelter and school rebuilds
properties.what: Built about 3,000 temporary shelters, ran medical camps, and rebuilt about 200 schools by mid-2024.
properties.needs: School reconstruction tracking, verification photos, and district-level delivery records.
properties.verification_status: reported by organization; cited in research brief

properties.name: Edhi emergency relief camps
properties.what: Ran roughly 300 emergency relief camps, recovered bodies, and distributed food rations to about 400,000 families.
properties.needs: Local camp locations, beneficiary testimony, and updated recovery status.
properties.verification_status: reported by organization; cited in research brief
properties.active_status: emergency response and ongoing welfare work

properties.name: Hindu Panchayat relief camps
properties.what: Hindu community networks in Tharparkar ran cross-religious relief points for displaced families, a response largely absent from international donor reporting.
properties.needs: Field verification, interviews, photos, and consented community profile.
properties.verification_status: reported in research brief; needs field verification

properties.name: Boatmen of Bhit Shah
properties.location_name: Bhit Shah and lower Sindh floodplain
properties.what: Sufi-shrine-affiliated fishermen reportedly used their own boats for rescues and transport, refusing reimbursement.
properties.needs: Primary interviews, route reconstruction, and archival photos.

properties.name: Aurat Foundation camp-safety advocacy
properties.what: Advocacy helped expose gender-blind relief conditions, including lack of women-only spaces, female medics, and menstrual hygiene support in early camps.
properties.needs: Specific camp examples, women-led interviews, and safety-sensitive documentation.
properties.verification_status: reported by UN Women/HRCP context; needs story-level sourcing
properties.source: EcoLens research brief; HRCP and UN Women context

properties.name: Mohana fishers of Manchar
properties.what: The Mohana fishing community was displaced when Manchar Lake expanded and breached; their knowledge is central to understanding what recovery means around the lake.
properties.needs: Consented field interviews, livelihood recovery status, and support pathways.
properties.verification_status: documented in reporting; needs EcoLens field profile
properties.source: EcoLens research brief; Dawn and NASA Earth Observatory context
